subject.title: Improve doctor/gateway diagnostics clarity for mixed LaunchAgent/runtime states

question: What final doctor diagnosis taxonomy and recovery-order output should OpenClaw standardize for mixed LaunchAgent, runtime, RPC, service-drift, and channel-conflict states?
rationale: Current main already gathers most of the underlying facts, but the public wording, state precedence, and whether to add a machine-readable diagnosis block are product/UX choices rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Compose a final doctor verdict
options.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps, reusing the existing service/runtime/RPC/channel facts.

options.title: Keep independent panels
options.body: Leave doctor output as separate panels and only improve individual messages when a specific transcript is reproduced.

options.title: Define JSON diagnosis first
options.body: Define a structured diagnosis object before changing user-facing prose, then render the final panel from that object later.

recommendation.title: Compose a final doctor verdict
recommendation.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps, reusing the existing service/runtime/RPC/channel facts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest central-path history is doctor orchestration plus LaunchAgent/bootstrap recovery work.
